description: This file defines a React component called UserProfileModal, which displays a read-only modal with user profile information including name, email, department, and tenant ID. The component manages focus trapping, animations, and accessibility features, and uses other custom components like Modal and Button.

methods.name: getFocusableElements
methods.description: Retrieves focusable elements within a given root element, filtering out hidden or non-visible elements.

methods.name: trapTabKey
methods.description: Handles trapping focus within the modal by cycling focus among focusable elements when Tab or Shift+Tab are pressed.
